SUB-SECOND LATENCY BUDGET & PROTOCOL INTEGRATION MATRIX
• RTSP / RTP / RTCP: H.264/H.265 video stream ingest

• MediaMTX API: Dynamic path registration & stream stats
• CORS & Auth: JWT Bearer Tokens & SDC subnet filters

• Vahan / Sarathi Schema: Standardized vehicle attributes
• PCR Dispatch Webhook: SMS / Telegram / Dial 112 event dispatch
• Forensic PDF Exporter: Chain-of-custody certified reports
• Air-Gapped Operation: Zero outbound internet requirements
